title: 3dMEMA
description: 3dMEMA is a program for performing Mixed Effects Meta Analysis at group level that models both within- and across-subjects variability.

prefix.description: Output prefix (just prefix, no view+suffix needed)
prefix.title: Output prefix

jobs.description: Number of jobs for parallel computing
jobs.title: Number of jobs

set.description: Set data for one of the test variables
set.title: Set data

covariates.description: Specify the name of a text file containing a table for the covariate(s).
covariates.title: Covariates file

covariates_center.description: Specify the center values for covariates.
covariates_center.title: Covariates center

covariates_model.description: Specify how covariates should be modeled.
covariates_model.title: Covariates model

covariates_name.description: Specify the name of each covariate.
covariates_name.title: Covariates name

groups.description: Label of groups, used for output naming.
groups.title: Groups

HKtest.description: Perform Hartung-Knapp adjustment for the output t-statistic.
HKtest.title: H-K test flag

mask.description: Only process voxels inside the specified mask.
mask.title: Mask file

max_zeros.description: Specify how many beta/t-statistics can be zero.
max_zeros.title: Maximum zeros allowed

model_outliers.description: Model outliers with a Laplace distribution.
model_outliers.title: Model outliers flag

n_nonzero.description: Number of non-zero beta values required.
n_nonzero.title: Minimum non-zero betas

no_HKtest.description: Specify not to use Hartung-Knapp adjustment.
no_HKtest.title: No H-K test flag

no_residual_Z.description: Do not output residuals and their Z values.
no_residual_Z.title: No residual Z flag

residual_Z.description: Output residuals and their Z values.
residual_Z.title: Residual Z flag

equal_variance.description: Assume same cross-subjects variability between groups.
equal_variance.title: Equal variance flag

unequal_variance.description: Model cross-subject variability difference between groups.
unequal_variance.title: Unequal variance flag

conditions.description: Name of 1 or 2 conditions, tasks, or GLTs
conditions.title: Conditions
